camera.slow-push: Slow, deliberate push-in toward the subject, gradually tightening the frame to draw the viewer into the character's inner state; steady, unhurried camera move.
camera.orbit: A smooth, weightless orbiting arc around the subject, revealing depth and layered space.
camera.shoulder: Over-the-shoulder framing holding the conversation, intimate and attentive.
camera.handheld: Subtle handheld movement breathing with the moment, raw and immediate.
camera.wide: A wide establishing shot placing the small figure within the larger space.
camera.drone: A high aerial drone shot surveying the scene from above.
camera.tracking: A smooth tracking shot following the subject's movement.
camera.zoom-in: A slow zoom pushing focus onto a single detail or expression.
camera.zoom-out: A slow zoom pulling back to reveal context and distance.
camera.crane: A rising crane shot lifting to reveal the scene opening up.
camera.rack-focus: A rack focus shifting attention from foreground to background.

emotion.anxiety: shallow breathing, restless unfocused eyes, small fidgeting hand movements, quiet inner tension
emotion.relief: shoulders easing down, a longer breath released, the faint beginning of a smile
emotion.hope: lifting the gaze, light catching the face, a cautious quiet openness
emotion.breakdown: emotion welling up and barely held back, eyes glistening, throat tight
emotion.awakening: a stilled, clearing gaze, the quiet of a sudden understanding settling in
emotion.loneliness: a small withdrawn figure in a large empty space, closed-in and quiet
emotion.fear: a held breath and a slight recoil (used sparingly, never rendered as horror)
emotion.joy: a relaxed, genuine warmth, the body visibly at ease

lighting.dawn: soft dawn light, gentle and hopeful, cool-to-warm gradient
lighting.dusk: golden dusk light, wistful and transitional
lighting.warm-lamp: warm amber lamplight and oil-lamp glow on aged wood, honey and amber tones
lighting.neon: cool neon city light, cyan and cold blue tones, reflections sliding on wet glass
lighting.moonlight: cool blue moonlight, quiet and introspective
lighting.backlight: strong backlight rimming the silhouette, mysterious
lighting.god-ray: a single volumetric god-ray cutting through deep black, catching drifting golden particles

捷運.desc: a near-empty Taipei MRT carriage at night, rain-streaked windows with neon reflections sliding across the glass, the carriage swaying gently
捷運.sound: muffled train rumble, a distant automated announcement, no music

車窗.desc: reflections on the rain-streaked window of a moving Taipei MRT carriage at night
車窗.sound: muffled train rumble, rain on glass

月台.desc: an MRT platform at night, cool signage light spilling into the carriage as the doors open

手機.desc: a close-up of a smartphone screen glowing in the dark, an unanswered message thread and a self-drawn Zi-wei natal chart visible
手機.sound: faint UI tap, ambient train noise

山.desc: a wet stone mountain path in the forest just after rain, dark blue turning to pale dawn, breath misting in the cold air
山.sound: footsteps on wet stone, dripping water, distant birdsong

石階.desc: wet stone steps climbing the misty mountainside at first light after rain
石階.sound: footsteps on wet stone, dripping water

呼吸.desc: an extreme close-up of breath misting in the cold dawn air on the mountain

堂.desc: the interior of a warm timber hall (Zi-wei Hall) on a mountainside at dawn, a low wooden table, an old clay teapot, oil lamps and a glowing golden natal chart on the table
堂.sound: a wooden creak, a distant wind chime, low warm room tone

命盤空間.desc: an abstract inner-mind space: pure deep black void with a large circular Chinese Zi-wei Dou-shu natal chart floating and slowly rotating, its stars and grid lines glowing luminous gold, drifting golden motes; mysterious and contemplative, NOT fantasy, NOT magical, a visualization of a human interior
命盤空間.sound: one sustained low tone, a single distant chime

街道.desc: a Taipei street just after rain, warm morning sunlight breaking through parting clouds and reflecting off wet pavement, amber warmth threading into the cool city, a moving crowd
街道.sound: footsteps, distant traffic, city life resuming

片尾.desc: a black end-title card, elegant gold Chinese text centered on deep black, faint drifting golden motes
片尾.sound: one sustained low tone slowly fading out

brand_guardrail: No horror, no superstition, no exaggeration, no supernatural elements. Cinematic, restrained, warm and human.
technical: Cinematic, anamorphic, shallow depth of field, 2.39:1, subtle film grain, high detail.
